scope: AMOS module interfaces for complex-argument Bessel functions with noninteger nonnegative order, including modified Bessel functions. The checked main compares J_0.3 and I_0.3 at 1+0.5i with independent convergent power series and K_0.5 with its closed form. Other argument regions, orders, scaling modes and Airy/Hankel routines are not validated. The upstream README warns of possible bugs.
